zh: 处于（某物）上面；置于（某物）顶端
en: to deal successfully with a difficulty
ex: She was well aware of the difficulties that had to be surmounted.
她很清楚必须克服哪些困难。

en: a name shared by all the members of a family (written last in English names)
ex: Rossi is a common surname in Italy.
Rossi （罗西）这个姓在意大利很常见。

en: to do or be better than somebody/something
ex: He hopes one day to surpass the world record.
他希望有一天能刷新世界纪录。

zh: more impressive than anything else of its kind
en: more impressive than anything else of its kind
ex: scenery of surpassing beauty
无比优美的景色

zh: （教士和唱诗班穿的）白色罩衣
en: a loose white piece of clothing with wide sleeves (= parts covering the arms) worn by priests and singers in the choir during church services

zh: 过剩；剩余；过剩量；剩余额
en: an amount that is extra or more than you need
ex: food surpluses
过剩的食物

zh: 意想不到（或突然）的事；令人惊奇的事（或消息等）
出人意表的做事方式；出奇制胜的策略
en: an event, a piece of news, etc. that is unexpected or that happens suddenly
ex: What a nice surprise!
真是让人惊喜！

zh: 惊奇的；惊讶的；觉得奇怪的；感觉意外的
en: feeling or showing surprise
ex: a surprised look
惊讶的神色

zh: 令人吃惊的；使人惊奇的；出人意料的；奇怪的
en: causing surprise
ex: It’s not surprising (that) they lost.
他们吃了败仗，不奇怪。

zh: 令人吃惊的；使人惊奇的；出人意料的；奇怪的
en: in a way that causes surprise
ex: She looked surprisingly well.
她看上去身体出奇地好。

zh: 离奇的；怪诞的；梦幻般的；超现实的
en: very strange; more like a dream than reality, with ideas and images mixed together in a strange way
ex: surreal images
超现实影像
